label: nyiso 13 citygate-gas
definition: (PROBE — REJECTED.) Mechanism-D test on the nyiso 11 keeper: --gas-hub-basis-overlay replaces the EIA-923 monthly gas RECEIPT series (winter-inflated; Jan-2023 $10.02/MMBtu, a Winter-Storm-Elliott billing artifact) with the monthly EIA NY-CITYGATE level already in the repo (Henry Hub + N3050NY3 basis, gas_basis_by_iso_month.csv), zonal spread + dual-fuel cap applied on top. It FIXES the winter (Jan resid +44->+14, CC fuel $39 vs actual $38; Feb held) -- confirming the winter over-price is a gas-series artifact, not scarcity -- but the EIA N3050NY3 'citygate' is an LDC/utility delivered price carrying summer demand charges, NOT the power-plant marginal spot, so it OVER-states summer by ~$10-13/MWh (Jul citygate $6.6 -> CC $46 vs actual $36; resid Jul +4->+46, Aug +2->+42). Net: monthly LMP MAE WORSENS 8.0/4.3/6.3 -> 21.5/22.2/24.2 and gas falls out of the +/-5% band (2023 -0.5%->-9.4% vs EIA-923; 2025 -6.4%->-13.4% vs EIA-930). 2023 net interchange incidentally improves to 97% (in band). REJECTED per the volume-band + don't-trade-one-axis-for-another guardrail; keeper nyiso 11 stands. The receipts (winter-high) and EIA citygate (summer-high) monthly proxies BRACKET the truth; the clean fix is a Transco-Z6 NY / Iroquois Z2 trading-hub SPOT series, distinct from both. See docs/nyiso-backcast-residual-attribution-2026-06.md.
